sections.heading: Manipal University Jaipur vs UEM Jaipur for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Manipal University Jaipur if you want a recorded NIRF 2025 #81, and a 2023 flagship package record of ₹8 LPA, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Jaipur.
Choose UEM Jaipur if you want a recorded fee of ₹1 lakh, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Jaipur.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.

Our records show ₹4.01 lakh as a tuition figure for MBA Finance at Manipal University Jaipur. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.
Our records show ₹1 lakh as a programme total for MBA Strategic Management at UEM Jaipur.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Manipal University Jaipur's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹8 LPA and a highest package of ₹42 LPA on MBA Finance. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for UEM Jaipur here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Manipal University Jaipur is listed on our records with CAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Our records do not list a confirmed entrance exam for UEM Jaipur on this page. Use the institute's current admission notice rather than last year's cut-off stories.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Rajasthan. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want a documented flagship placement year, Manipal University Jaipur is the clearer record here, because UEM Jaipur has no 2020-or-later flagship package on this page.
Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether UEM Jaipur's recorded ₹1 lakh or Manipal University Jaipur's ₹4.01 lakh fits your budget for this MBA / PGDM.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
